title: ITA/97/2007 of COMMISSIONER OF INCOME TAX Vs M/S KISAN SAHKARI CHINI MILLS LTD

paras.text:
ITA No. 97 of 2007
Hon'ble J.S. Khehar, C.J.
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Civil Misc. Recall/Correction Application No. 1691/2007
 Mr. Arvind Vashisth, Advocate for the non-applicant/appellant.
 Ms. Puja Banga, Advocate for the applicant /respondent.
 Learned counsel for the applicant /respondent states, that it would be
more appropriate to file a review application in respect of the prayer made
in the instant Civil Misc. Recall/Correction Application. She further states,
that she may be allowed to withdraw the instant application with liberty to
file a review application on the same cause of action.
 Prayer made by the applicant/respondent is not opposed by the
learned counsel representing the non-applicant/appellant.
 In view of the above, Civil Misc. Recall/Correction Application No.
1691/2007 is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to the applicant
/respondent to file a review application, if the applicant/respondent is so
advised in accordance with law.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.) (J.S. Khehar, C.J.)
 08.02.2010
P.Singh
